Class SpatialCamera

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.SpatialCamera
public class SpatialCamera extends Object
This class offers methods to adjust a custom camera and methods to get camera coordinates (walk-through camera).

    • setCustomCameraInMainView

      public static void setCustomCameraInMainView(boolean mainView)
      Displays the custom camera in the main view. With the split view the small view then shows the normal camera (rotated with the mouse). Else (the default) the custom camera is displayed in the small view of the split view. Without the split view the custom camera is always displayed in the view.
      Parameters:
      mainView - true for the main view

    • setMainCameraEnabled

      public static void setMainCameraEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Uses the camera of the main view (see setMainCamera) instead of the camera rotated with the mouse: another perspective without a rotation of the world (e.g., with the custom camera in the small view of the split view). The custom camera has priority if it is displayed in the main view.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to use the main view camera

    • isMainCameraEnabled

      public static boolean isMainCameraEnabled()
      Returns true if the main view camera is used.
      Returns:
      true if the main view camera is enabled
